DivinecraftFire.description: Direct hits burn for 4 seconds, dealing average physical damage every second.

ForsakenFameCancel.name: Forsaken Fame [Cancel]
ForsakenFameCancel.description: Ends at the damage hit. Follow immediately with Deflect or a skill other than Forsaken Fame or an Umbrella skill.

RibbonHeavy3PreVC.name: Waist Drum: Heavy Attack 3 · Follow-up Setup

RibbonHeavyComboVC.name: Waist Drum: Heavy Attack 1–3 → Rhythm of Accord

SecondTrackSlash1Release.name: Second Track Slash Stage 1 Release [4 Hits]

SecondTrackSlash1ReleaseCancel.name: Second Track Slash Stage 1 Release [4 Hits][Cancel]

DivinecraftFire.name: Divinecraft - Fire
DivinecraftFire.description: Direct hits burn for 4 seconds, dealing average physical damage every second.

DivinecraftPoison.name: Divinecraft - Poison
DivinecraftPoison.description: Direct hits poison for 8 seconds, dealing average physical damage every second.

Tailwind.name: Rustling
Tailwind.description: Increases all attribute attacks by 3% (6% when paired with Ribbon & Drum). With Ribbon & Drum talents, also increases Drum Series base damage by 40%.

RadiantDrum.name: Radiant Drum
RadiantDrum.description: Increases Physical Attack and all attribute attacks by 6%. With Ribbon & Drum talents, also increases Drum Series base damage by 40%.

Cloudshear.name: Cloudshear: Wings
Cloudshear.description: Increases all damage and healing by 6%.

FlowingWind.name: Driftbreeze
FlowingWind.description: Enhances Fan Q into Boundless Bloom.

EndlessGale.name: Endless Gale
EndlessGale.description: Applied by Nameless Spear's Martial Art Skill Qiankun's Lock. Mountain's Might T0 sets its duration to 10 seconds and T4 grants Direct Affinity Rate while it is active.

FragrantSongResonance.name: Fragrant Song - Resonance
FragrantSongResonance.description: Marks the throw that started with Fragrant Song. Its creation and accepted-catch Resonances use that throw's bonus until the throw's recovery cleanup clears the marker. A catch may ready Fragrant Song for the following throw without changing this marker; each throw also clears and re-primes it at start.

PhantomUmbrella.name: Phantom Umbrella
PhantomUmbrella.description: A summoned world object, not a stat buff. One exists per player: a new summon replaces the previous one rather than accumulating, and it expires after five seconds.

PhantomUmbrellaThrow.name: Phantom Umbrella Summon Cadence
PhantomUmbrellaThrow.description: Counts returning umbrella throws since the last summon. Scarlet Spin primes this to two, so the first returning throw reaches the cap of three and summons, and the next summons fall on the fourth, seventh, tenth and thirteenth throw of that cast. Reaching the cap consumes the count so the next three throws are counted again.

Soulbound.name: Soulbound
Soulbound.description: Lasts until Piercing Dart is cast. Charging does not consume it.

Starweave.name: Starweave
Starweave.description: Martial Art Skills deal 3% increased damage per stack, plus distance-scaled bonus damage beyond 4 meters, up to 1% at 8 meters. Stacks up to 5 times, one stack is removed when you take damage, and at most 2 stacks can be gained per second.

DragonHeadTide.name: Dragon Head - Tide
DragonHeadTide.description: Increases damage by 0.45% per percentage point of HP missing at hit time.

Intoxicated.name: Intoxicated
Intoxicated.description: Allow using Drunken Poet or Dragon's Breath.

EnhanceDrunkenPoet.name: Enhanced Drunken Poet
EnhanceDrunkenPoet.description: Each stack increases Drunken Poet's fifth hit damage by 20%.

Flute.name: Flute
Flute.description: Buff damage by the distance to the target.

SurgingWaves.name: Surging Waves
SurgingWaves.description: Boosts Dragon Head - Tide damage by 1.25% per stack. Doubles its base damage against an Exhausted target.

WorldToSword.name: World to Sword
WorldToSword.description: Accumulates overhealing and launches up to 20 Qi Blades.

Turnaround.name: Turnaround
Turnaround.description: Refunds 30% of a Mystic skill's Vitality cost, up to 10 Vitality.

Hawkwing.name: Hawkwing
Hawkwing.description: Increases Physical Attack and Bellstrike Attack by 1.8% per stack.

Bloom.name: Bloom
Bloom.description: The spring outcome of Seasonal Edge.

Flare.name: Flare
Flare.description: Increases All Martial Arts by 10%, plus another 10% above 75% HP.

Yield.name: Yield
Yield.description: Increases Mystic Skill damage by 10% and restores 2 Vitality per second.

Frost.name: Frost
Frost.description: The winter outcome of Seasonal Edge.

BreakingPointCooldown.name: Breakpoint Cooldown
BreakingPointCooldown.description: Breaking Point's Tier VI dodge effect is on cooldown. Ordinary Disintegration stacks remain available.

SeasonalEdgeCooldown.name: Seasonal Edge Cooldown
SeasonalEdgeCooldown.description: Seasonal Edge cannot trigger while this effect is active.

RisingMomentum.name: Rising Momentum
RisingMomentum.description: A successful deflection increases HP damage by 2% per stack for 5 seconds, up to 10 stacks. Only available against a boss.

DivinecraftFireEmber.name: Divinecraft - Fire Ember Count
DivinecraftFireEmber.description: Counts direct hits since the last Solid Foundation. Five hits consume the count and grant Solid Foundation, which is re-granted at most once every 10 seconds.

DivinecraftSolidFoundation.name: Divinecraft - Fire Solid Foundation
DivinecraftSolidFoundation.description: The next direct hit unleashes Solid Foundation. Re-granted at most once every 10 seconds.

YiRiver.name: Yi River
YiRiver.description: Increases damage and healing by 1% per stack; T1 adds 2 Physical Penetration per stack. T3 doubles the damage/healing bonus against controlled targets.

RighteousLight.name: Light
RighteousLight.description: Increases Righteous Return by 10% per stack.

RighteousDarkness.name: Darkness
RighteousDarkness.description: Increases Relentless Combat by 10% per stack.

MistwillowGracefulWillow.name: Graceful Willow
MistwillowGracefulWillow.description: Increases Physical and Silkbind damage of matching attacks by 10%. Refreshes at most once every 2 seconds.

MistwillowDenseSmoke.name: Dense Smoke
MistwillowDenseSmoke.description: Increases Physical and Silkbind damage of matching attacks by 10%. Refreshes at most once every 2 seconds.

Mistwillow.name: Mistwillow
Mistwillow.description: Increases Physical and Silkbind damage of matching attacks by 10%. Refreshes at most once every 2 seconds.

AdaptiveSteelHengBlade.name: Varied Combo DMG Boost
AdaptiveSteelHengBlade.description: After a Heng Blade deflection, increases Light/Heavy Varied Combo damage by 5% for 5 seconds. Triggers once every 20 seconds.

Cadence.name: Cadence
Cadence.description: Stores successful defenses for later Riposte conversions.

Riposte.name: Riposte
Riposte.description: Reduces the cast time of the next Avalanche by 2 seconds.

InnerPassion.name: Inner Passion
InnerPassion.description: Hasten and increase damage to Burning Heart.

ThroatPierced.name: Throat-Pierced
ThroatPierced.description: Gain 2 Physical Penetration and 2% Critical Damage per stack. From T3, Light/Heavy Varied Combos gain an additional 1 Penetration and 1% Critical Damage per stack. From T6, Anxi Soldier and its triggering skill gain the same additional bonus.

Cleftpeak.name: Cleftpeak
Cleftpeak.description: Increase HP damage by 1% per stack. Additional 8% to Light VC, Heavy VC, Anxi Soldier, and its triggering skill at max stack.

MountainSplitter.name: Mountain Splitter
MountainSplitter.description: Increase the critical damage of Burning Heart and Anxi Soldier by 10% and gain guaranteed crit.

Drumbeat.name: Drumbeat
Drumbeat.description: Increases Charged Skill damage by 15%. Converted into Breakthrough by Predator's Shield.

HardenedFoe.name: Hardened Foe
HardenedFoe.description: Increases damage by 10% after a shield breaks.

RodentRampageEnhancement.name: Rodent Rampage Enhancement
RodentRampageEnhancement.description: RD Special consumes one stack to apply Enhanced Rodent Rampage instead of Rodent Rampage.

Disintegration.name: Disintegration
Disintegration.description: Increase physical penetraion by 5 and critical damage by 5% per stack.

Samsara.name: Samsara
Samsara.description: Increases HP damage dealt by 5%. Echoes of Oblivion T6 adds another 5%.

EnhancedRodentRampage.name: Enhanced Rodent Rampage
EnhancedRodentRampage.description: Retains coordinated Rodent attacks. Automatic Rodents launch at +0.5s, then every second, and land 0.5s later. Lasts 10 seconds, 15 with Vendetta, or 20 at Vendetta T4.

HeavensUnity.name: Heaven's Unity
HeavensUnity.description: Increases Celestial Mandate's Heaven's Will generation from 0.1 to 0.3.

Etherwrath.name: Etherwrath
Etherwrath.description: Increases all attack values by 1.2% per stack. At five stacks, Martial Art Effects gain 6 of every penetration type.

Cognition.name: Cognition
Cognition.description: Each stack grants Martial Art Effects 2 of every attribute penetration. Heavenwill Gauntlets Falcon effects and Vile Condemned effects gain another 2 per stack. At Empirical Edge T6, Physical Penetration increases by the same amount.

EchoesOfAThousandPlants.name: Echoes of a Thousand Plants
EchoesOfAThousandPlants.description: Heals once per second after a 1-second delay and increases healing by 15%.

MorningDrizzle.name: Morning Drizzle
MorningDrizzle.description: Heals once per second for 5 seconds, beginning immediately.

Concentration.name: Concentration
Concentration.description: Increases Affinity DMG by 10%. Insightful Strike T3 also increases Direct Affinity Rate while active.

ThunderSummoning.name: Thunder Summoning
ThunderSummoning.description: Increases damage by 30% for 15 seconds through the Mechanism damage category.

Disarm.name: Disarm
Disarm.description: Increases general damage bonus against the target by 200% for 11 seconds.

TangledGauze.name: Tangled Gauze
TangledGauze.description: Roots the target and prevents most skills. Drum Q2 deals 20% additional damage to affected bosses.

InkRhyme.name: Ink Rhythm
InkRhyme.description: Increases Fan and Drum Series damage against the target by 5% and reduces its outgoing damage by 5%. Zephyr Whispers T4 increases both effects to 10% against non-player targets.

Cuncao.name: Blade of Grass
Cuncao.description: Blade's Will stacks require an eligible varied attack, including Rhythm of Accord or End of Gale, to hit at least 3 enemies simultaneously (2 at T4; 3 grants 2 stacks). Lasts 5s, or 8s at T1; up to 5 stacks. Eligible attacks deal 2% more damage per stack, increased to 4% at T3. T6 adds 5% damage against targets at 5 stacks. Cannot build stacks against a single target.

WarriorMark.name: Farewell
WarriorMark.description: Envigorated Warrior T6: for 5s, attacks from this target do not disable the damage/healing bonus. Incoming attacks are attributed to the simulator’s selected target.

FearfulBlade.name: Fearful Blade
FearfulBlade.description: Reduces attribute resistances by 16 and increases 8% HP damage for Strength

Vulnerable.name: Vulnerable
Vulnerable.description: Increases HP damage taken by 8%, with an additional 10% for Might. Does not increase Qi damage.

QiImbalance.name: Qi Imbalance
QiImbalance.description: Increases Qi damage taken by 10%. Increases global HP damage taken by 10% during exhausted, and an additional 10% for Bellstrike damage.

SwordSlashDamageBoost.name: Sword Slash Damage Boost
SwordSlashDamageBoost.description: Increases SwordEnergy skill damage by 10% per stack, up to 3 stacks. Hits refresh the 8-second duration.

SoulShaken.name: Soul-Shaken
SoulShaken.description: Ordinary DoT damage taken increases by 5% per stack, plus 5% for Strategic Sword or Heavenquaker Spear. High Bleed instead receives 10% per stack; these bonuses do not stack.

PhantomChime.name: Phantom Chime
PhantomChime.description: Reduces Physical Resistance by 2 per stack.

Wildstride.name: Wildstride
Wildstride.description: While Strayhunt (Draught) is active, increases Replayed skill damage by 20%.

Strayhunt.name: Strayhunt
Strayhunt.description: Increases Physical DMG Bonus and all four attribute DMG Bonuses by 2%.

BoneCorrosion.name: Bone Corrosion
BoneCorrosion.description: Increases Qi damage from the applier by 5%, or 40% for Light Attacks.

Sin.name: Sin
Sin.description: Echoes of Oblivion mark. Lasts 3 seconds, refreshes on application, and stacks once.

Karma.name: Karma
Karma.description: Echoes of Oblivion mark. Lasts 3 seconds, refreshes on application, and stacks once.

HeavensMight.name: Heaven's Might
HeavensMight.description: Increases HP damage from Falcon and Vile Condemned skills by 10%.

VileCondemnedEndCooldown.name: Vile Condemned End Cooldown
VileCondemnedEndCooldown.description: Prevents Vile Condemned from selecting End Hit.

QingyisCharmT0.name: Bitter Seasons
QingyisCharmT0.description: Reduces Physical Defense by 0.6% per stack.

QingyisCharmT1.name: Bitter Seasons
QingyisCharmT1.description: Reduces Physical Defense by 1.2% per stack.

QingyisCharmT6.name: Bitter Seasons
QingyisCharmT6.description: Reduces Physical Defense by 1.2% per stack. At 5 stacks, additionally reduces Physical Resistance by 10.

Controlled.name: Controlled
Controlled.description: Marks a target as controlled for conditional effects.

DivinecraftFire.name: Divinecraft - Fire
DivinecraftFire.description: Direct hits burn for 4 seconds, dealing average physical damage every second.

DivinecraftPoison.name: Divinecraft - Poison
DivinecraftPoison.description: Direct hits poison for 8 seconds, dealing average physical damage every second.

normalization: Refs are zero-based indices into pools. For each contact, sum(branch.probability * pools.traces[traceRef].result.total), then multiply vitalityScale. action.damageScale already includes any emitted-event probability; do not multiply hitProbability again.
